Tidy trajectories saved alongside monty samples

Source: R/samples.R
tidy_trajectories.Rd

Convert the trajectories, final state or snapshots saved with a set of samples into a long-format tibble. These are saved when the likelihood is created with save_trajectories, save_state or save_snapshots (see dust2::dust_likelihood_monty()), and are also present in the output of run_parameter_sets().

Usage

tidy_trajectories(
  samples,
  obj = NULL,
  times = NULL,
  save_trajectories = NULL,
  n_draws = NULL,
  vars = NULL,
  dims = NULL,
  labels = NULL
)

tidy_state(
  samples,
  obj = NULL,
  n_draws = NULL,
  vars = NULL,
  dims = NULL,
  labels = NULL
)

tidy_snapshots(
  samples,
  obj = NULL,
  times,
  n_draws = NULL,
  vars = NULL,
  dims = NULL,
  labels = NULL
)

Arguments

samples

A monty_samples object, from monty::monty_sample() or run_parameter_sets().

obj

The filter or unfilter (a dust_likelihood object) that the samples were created with. Not needed for output from run_parameter_sets().

times

Times for the trajectories. By default these are taken from obj (the times of the data) or from the samples. For tidy_snapshots() these are the snapshot times and are required.

save_trajectories

If the likelihood was created with save_trajectories as a character vector of variable names, that same vector.

n_draws

Optional number of draws to keep, selected at random from all chains.

vars

Optional character vector of variables to keep, for example c("I", "incidence"). Selecting variables before reshaping is much cheaper than filtering afterwards.

dims

Optional names for the dimensions of array variables. Either an unnamed character vector applied by position to every array variable (c("age", "vax")), or a named list giving the dimension names of each variable (list(S = c("age", "vax"), R = "age")). Dimensions that are not named produce columns index1, index2, and so on.

labels

Optional named list of labels for dimensions, for example list(age = c("child", "adult")). Labelled dimensions become factors. Use the name group to label parameter groups.

Value

A tibble with columns .chain, .iteration, .draw, group and particle (where present), time (except for tidy_state()), variable, one column per array dimension and value.

Details

Samples from monty::monty_sample() do not record which state variables were saved or at what times, so the filter used to create the likelihood is needed as obj. Output from run_parameter_sets() carries this information with it and obj can be omitted.

Trajectories can be very large (variables x times x draws). Use vars and n_draws to reduce them before reshaping.
